$description: Micah Hoang design tokens. Source of truth for code/design-system. Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) with $value/$type. Values were measured from the published micahhoang.com and the Framer text/color styles on 2026-10-01. Edit here, then run `node build.mjs` to regenerate tokens.css. Supersedes code/tokens/micahhoang-tokens.json (Manrope era, stale).

cream.$description: Framer style /Cream. Page background, text on Forest Green.

forest-green.$description: Framer style /Forest Green. Brand color: headings, nav, mono labels; inverse surface for footer and boot loader.

accent-green.$description: Interactive green. Hover/active for tags, filters and index controls. Never a fill.

near-black.$description: Rules, dividers, index list text, lightbox chrome, emphasized body.

graphite.$description: Long-form body copy on case studies.

light-gray.$description: Framer style Light Gray. Secondary headline line, tag text, thumbnail stroke.

grain-umber.$description: Grain overlay tint. Used only in the texture layer.

cream.$description: Semantic roles on the default Cream surface (data-surface="cream").

inverse.$description: Footer, boot loader, any inverted block.

media.$description: Placeholder behind media before it loads; lightbox backdrop.

brand.$description: Display type, nav, mono labels, section headers.

strong.$description: Lead body, metadata values, index rows, H3.

muted.$description: Second headline line, tags, tertiary meta.

interactive.$description: Hover and active state for tags, filters, toggles.

green.$description: Semantic roles on the Forest Green surface (data-surface="green").

sans.$description: GT Standard L. 400 Regular, 500 Medium (Trial L Md), 700 Bold (Trial L Bd).

type.$description: Composite text styles. size/leading/tracking per breakpoint: desktop (>=1200), tablet (810-1199), mobile (<810). Tracking is in em.

display-xl.$description: Home hero name only. Framer: Heading 1. One per site.

display-l.$description: Case-study title plus muted continuation line. Framer: Heading 2b.

display-m.$description: Section header (Selected work, About Micah, Index). Framer: Heading 2.

display-footer.$description: Footer contact links on Forest Green.

heading.$description: Hero descriptor and case-study section titles. Framer: Heading 3.

title.$description: Index row project titles (uppercase GT Standard). Framer: Index Title (scaled).

body-lg.$description: Lead paragraphs, About copy, metadata values. Framer: Body.

body.$description: Case-study long-form body. Color text.body. Max ~620px measure.

body-sm.$description: Small paragraphs, captions. Framer: Paragraph Regular.

label.$description: Mono label: nav, meta, eyebrows, actions. Framer: Heading 5 / Body - 100%.

gutter.$description: Page side padding. Content spans edge to edge inside it.

none.$description: Default. Media, sections and surfaces are square.

hairline.$description: The only border width in the system.

snappy.$description: Default. Decelerating ease-out for reveals, hover transforms, media scale, fades.

smooth.$description: Symmetric: line/rule draws, small UI state changes, row hover wash.

springy.$description: Gesture-only (cursor trails, Line Animation draw). Do not use for UI state.

base.$description: Hover transforms: flip rail, media scale.

reveal.$description: Type mask reveal; also scroll-to-top travel.

flip-gap.$description: Gap between stacked copies in the flip rail.

spring.$description: For NEW gesture-driven UI only (drag, swipe, sheets, anything the user can grab mid-flight). Existing live components keep their bezier curves. Apple's damping ratio + response model; in Motion/Framer Motion use { type: 'spring', bounce: 1 - damping, duration: response }.

default.$description: Critically damped, no overshoot. Repositioning, settling, snapping.

quick.$description: Small, close-range moves: toggles, thumbs, short slides.

momentum.$description: Only after a flick or throw carried velocity. Never for UI that just appeared.

gesture.$description: Values the live /play archive already ships (ArchivePlayground.tsx). Reuse for new gesture UI; do not retune /play.

tap-threshold.$description: Movement before a press becomes a drag.

throw-friction.$description: Velocity multiplier per 60fps frame (exponential decay, ~0.990 per ms, Apple's 'snappy' rate).

throw-min-speed.$description: px/s below which a release does not throw.

none.$description: The brand is flat. Separate layers with rules, surfaces and space, never shadows.

grain.$description: Grain starts below the nav (Clear Nav), so it never needs to sit above it.
